capital_model: Separate independent ₹10,000 cash account for each strategy candidate; full premium debit is at risk; one lot; no leverage or fractional lots.
warning: If a one-lot option premium exceeds the per-trade risk budget, the trade is skipped. A zero-trade result means the requested capital and risk limits are incompatible with available contract lot sizes/premiums.

chronological_holdout.method: Fixed rules; chronological 70/30 split by entry session; separate ₹10,000 account reset in each period; no parameters fitted on validation.
chronological_holdout.warning: A period with zero feasible trades is not a strategy pass. The validation segment is independent of the training segment but historical data may still be subject to source and execution limitations.
